method.reason: Select PBE0 under the 4-core/192 MB process budget. ORCA documentation identifies PBE0 as a global hybrid with 25% HF exchange, suitable for a bounded linear-response TDDFT calculation of valence singlet excitations in acetone. This selection is a planning choice, not independent scientific validation; the calculation will need to specify full TDDFT rather than TDA, 5 roots, singlets only, and gas-phase conditions.

basis.reason: Select def2-SVP as an affordable polarized valence double-zeta basis for acetone C/O/H. The official ORCA basis documentation lists def2-SVP with H–Rn coverage and ECPs for heavier elements, so all acetone elements are covered. Diffuse functions are absent, so Rydberg states are not targeted; this limitation remains explicit.
